correctness.rationale: The positive definite inverse-trace representation is strictly convex in all independent edge weights. Dihedral invariance thus holds at the unrestricted unique optimizer. Positive semidefinite monotonicity saturates every rim-vertex capacity, Fourier blocks give the exact rational scalar objective, Jensen/Cauchy prove its n>=7 endpoint sign, exact calculations settle n=4..6 and a quartic settles n=3, and the cyclic Poisson kernel supplies the exact value and asymptotics. Actual verify_gear.py passed 528 finite direct-eigenvalue/symbolic/numerical assertions. No infinite claim relies solely on finite sampling.

value.rationale: Gear graphs are a canonical alternating hub/ring family. The theorem establishes all-size unrestricted optimal transition weights, an exact hub-holding transition already at n=4, a closed-form optimum with sharp four-term asymptotics, and an unbounded sqrt(n) improvement over the conventional max-degree design. This is a structural graph-constrained stochastic-optimization classification rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
